description: FridgeGhost agent hooks — run the typecheck before committing and never let a secret into the repo.

hooks.description: Run the TypeScript compiler (tsc, strict) before every commit. If it fails, the commit is blocked until the type errors are fixed. This is the project's only automated gate: there is no test runner in the MVP, so a green build is the minimum bar for landing code.
hooks.name: typecheck-before-commit

hooks.command: echo 'FridgeGhost needs no secrets: no API keys, no tokens, no credentials. If this commit adds a .env file, a key, a token, or a password, stop and remove it before committing.'
hooks.description: Remind the agent (and the human) that this repo must never contain secrets. FridgeGhost runs entirely on free, keyless public APIs (Open Food Facts, TheMealDB). Any credential in a commit is a mistake by definition.
hooks.name: no-secrets-reminder

hooks.description: Best-effort scan of staged changes for things that look like assigned credentials (key/secret/token/password with a quoted value). Prints matching filenames, if any, so they can be reviewed before commit. This is a heuristic tripwire, not a guarantee — the reminder hook above is the real rule.
hooks.name: no-secrets-scan
